ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, N is marked near the upper vertical line and is the North Pole; A and B are located on the left and right sides, and the dawn-dusk line shown by AB is arc-shaped and tangent to the parallel marked 80°N; below, the line from A through C, M, D to B is the equator, M is below the middle vertical line, C is on the left side of the equator, and D is on the right side of the equator; the curve CND passes through C, N, and D, and D is indeed the right-side intersection of this equal-solar-altitude line on the equator. Reasoning: The dawn-dusk line being tangent to the 80°N parallel indicates that near 80°N there is the critical condition of polar day or polar night, and the solar declination δ is about 90°-80°=10°N. CND is the equal-solar-altitude line at 9 o'clock Beijing time, and it passes through N and D, so the solar altitude at point D is the same as the solar altitude at the North Pole; the solar altitude at the North Pole is approximately equal to the solar declination, namely h_N≈10°, so h_D≈10°. D is on the equator, and the solar altitude formula at the equator is sin h=cosδ·cosH. Substituting h≈10° and δ≈10° gives sin10°=cos10°·cosH, so cosH=tan10°, and H is a little more than about 79°, which converts to about 5 hours 15 minutes to 5 hours 20 minutes. In the figure, D is on the right side, belonging to the afternoon half-day arc, so the local time at point D is about 12:00+5 hours 15 minutes≈17:15.

At this time, approximately what is the time at point D?

method.method_draft: 先从图像确认D是等太阳高度线CND在赤道上的右侧交点。由文字给出的AB为晨昏线且与80°N相切，判断此时太阳赤纬δ约为10°N。因为CND是等太阳高度线且经过N、D，所以D点太阳高度等于北极点太阳高度，即h_D=h_N≈10°。D在赤道上，代入赤道太阳高度关系 sin10°=cos10°·cosH，得 cosH=tan10°，H≈79°多，约为5小时15分到5小时20分。图中D在右侧为下午支，故D点地方时≈12:00+5小时15分≈17时15分。
